verdict.rationale: Whether customer data is used for AI model training is a fair question for a SaaS platform that ingests customer data and ships AI features (AgentControl, LLM observability), so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented AI-training opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no data-usage policy. FedRAMP compliance and self-hosted Relay Proxy are adjacent controls, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
